name: arXiv 2406.02532: SpecExec: Massively Parallel Speculative Decoding for Interactive LLM Inference on Consumer Devices
notes: NeurIPS 2024 paper by Ruslan Svirschevski, Avner May, Zhuoming Chen, Beidi Chen, Zhihao Jia, Max Ryabinin. Code at https://github.com/yandex-research/specexec. Introduces massively parallel speculative execution constructing cache trees of high-probability continuations from draft model, validated in a single pass of target model during RAM/SSD parameter offloading. Evaluates on RTX 4090, RTX 3090, RTX 4060, and A100.
